login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: to manage your storage with {app}
login.note: Your storage keys never leave the server.

setup.title: Can’t reach your storage
setup.noBuckets: This key can’t see any buckets.
setup.hint: Check your environment variables and restart the server.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.styleHint: How strongly the chosen color tints the interface.
appearance.deviceNote: These settings are saved on this device only.

files.title: Files
files.searchLimited: Search stops after 500 results or 50,000 scanned files. Narrow it down by opening a subfolder.
files.name: Name
files.deleteFoldersNote: Folders are deleted with everything inside them.
files.deleteNote: Every version is removed so the space is really freed. This can’t be undone.
files.foldersSkipped: Folders are skipped. Select files to download.
files.noPublicUrls: No public URLs: this bucket is private and has no CDN configured.
files.emptyText: Drop files here, or use Upload.
files.noMatchesHint: Search looks at file names under the current folder.

preview.noPreview: No preview for this file type
preview.noPreviewHint: Download it or open its details.

newFolder.name: Folder name
newFolder.hint: Storage has no real folders: this creates an empty “{name}/” marker.

rename.fileNote: The file is copied to the new name, then the old one is removed with its version history.
rename.folderNote: Everything inside is copied to the new path, then the old objects are removed with their version history.

move.noSubfolders: No subfolders here. Type a new path above to create it.
move.moveNote: Moving removes the originals with their version history.
move.overwriteText: These already exist at the destination. Their current content becomes an old version.

share.title: Share file
share.publicNote: Served through your CDN or public bucket. Works for as long as the file exists.
share.privateNote: This bucket is private and has no CDN URL configured, so there’s no permanent link. Create a signed link instead.
share.signedNote: Anyone with the link can download the file until it expires.

info.title: Details
info.noVersions: Version history isn’t available for this endpoint.
info.restoreText: It’s copied over the current file as a new version.

stats.title: Usage
stats.scanSlow: Large buckets can take a few minutes.
stats.costNote: A rescan lists every object version (about one class C call per 1,000 versions).
stats.truncated: The scan stopped at 2,000,000 versions. These numbers are partial.
stats.oldWarning: {size} is held by old versions and hidden files.
stats.byFolderSubPrefix: Current files, top level of this folder

buckets.title: Buckets
buckets.emptyText: Create one to start uploading files.
buckets.s3Only: Bucket settings and keys need the B2 native API. They’re turned off while an S3 endpoint override is set.
buckets.globalNames: Bucket names are unique across the whole provider.
buckets.name: Bucket name

settings.title: Bucket settings
settings.needsNative: Bucket settings use the B2 native API. Remove the S3_ENDPOINT override to turn them on.
settings.visibilityText: Public buckets serve files to anyone who has the URL. Private ones need signed links.
settings.publicOn: Files can be downloaded by anyone with the URL.
settings.publicOff: Files are only reachable through signed links.
settings.makePublicText: Every file in the bucket becomes downloadable by anyone who knows its URL.
settings.makePrivateText: Public URLs and your CDN stop working until you switch back.
settings.cdnHint: Set CDN_URLS={bucket}=https://your-cdn to copy CDN links instead.
settings.deleteText: Only empty buckets can be deleted. Delete every file (and version) first.

cors.title: CORS
cors.text: Uploads go straight from your browser to storage, so the bucket must allow this app’s address.
cors.mustBeArray: Rules must be a JSON array.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle rules
lifecycle.text: Hide files after a number of days, and delete hidden or old versions after a number of days. Leave a field empty for never.
lifecycle.none: No rules: every version of every file is kept forever.
lifecycle.needsNumber: Each rule needs at least one number.

multipart.title: Unfinished large uploads
multipart.text: Parts of interrupted uploads take up (billed) space until they’re canceled.

keys.title: Application keys
keys.subtitle: Keys for apps and scripts. A secret is shown only once, right after it’s created.
keys.deleteText: Anything using this key stops working immediately.
keys.name: Key name
keys.createdNote: Copy the secret now. It will never be shown again.

errors.network: Can’t reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
errors.bucketNameRules: Bucket names are 6–50 characters: letters, digits and dashes, not starting with “b2-”.
errors.keyNameRules: Key names use only letters, digits and dashes.
errors.ownKey: This app runs on that key, so it can’t be deleted here.
errors.nativeApiRequired: This needs the B2 native API (no S3_ENDPOINT override).
errors.jobNotFound: The operation was lost (the server may have restarted).
errors.folderIntoItself: A folder can’t be moved into itself.
errors.deleteRoot: Refusing to delete an empty key or the bucket root.
errors.uploadCors: Network or CORS error. Allow uploads in the bucket’s CORS settings.
errors.etagMissing: The storage didn’t expose the ETag header. Allow uploads in the bucket’s CORS settings.

config.secret: SESSION_SECRET must be at least 32 characters.
config.b2: B2_KEY_ID and B2_APP_KEY are not set.
